scope: division-free cofactor and completion deficit; no gcd/strong-divisibility/FLT closure

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor
declarations.source_signature: def powerDifferenceCofactor {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (x y : R) : R

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_zero
declarations.source_signature:
@[simp] theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_zero {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (x y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor 0 x y = 0

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_one
declarations.source_signature:
@[simp] theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_one {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (x y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor 1 x y = 1

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_add_eq_GTail
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_add_eq_GTail
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (g y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor n (g + y) y = GTail n 1 g y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_eq_GTail_sub
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_eq_GTail_sub
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor n x y = GTail n 1 (x - y) y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_eq_GTail_nat_sub
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_eq_GTail_nat_sub
    (n x y : ℕ) (hyx : y ≤ x) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor n x y = GTail n 1 (x - y) y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_add_succ
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_add_succ
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (g y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor (n + 1) (g + y) y =
      y * powerDifferenceCofactor n (g + y) y + (g + y) ^ n

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_succ
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_succ
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor (n + 1) x y = y * powerDifferenceCofactor n x y + x ^ n

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_two
declarations.source_signature:
@[simp] theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_two {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (x y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor 2 x y = x + y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_recurrence
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_recurrence
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (k : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor (k + 2) x y + x * y * powerDifferenceCofactor k x y =
      (x + y) * powerDifferenceCofactor (k + 1) x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.sub_mul_powerDifferenceCofactor
declarations.source_signature:
theorem sub_mul_powerDifferenceCofactor
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    (x - y) * powerDifferenceCofactor n x y = x ^ n - y ^ n

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_diagonal
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_diagonal
    {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (n : ℕ) (x : R) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor n x x = n * x ^ (n - 1)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_le
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_le (n x y : ℕ) :
    powerDifferenceCofactor n x y ≤ (x + y) ^ (n - 1)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_pos
declarations.source_signature:
theorem powerDifferenceCofactor_pos (k x y : ℕ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    0 < powerDifferenceCofactor (k + 1) x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.signedCompletionDefect
declarations.source_signature: def signedCompletionDefect {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (x y : R) : R

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.signedCompletionDefect_add_cofactor
declarations.source_signature:
theorem signedCompletionDefect_add_cofactor
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    signedCompletionDefect n x y + powerDifferenceCofactor n x y =
      (x + y) ^ (n - 1)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.signedCompletionDefect_recurrence
declarations.source_signature:
theorem signedCompletionDefect_recurrence
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (k : ℕ) (x y : R) :
    signedCompletionDefect (k + 3) x y =
      (x + y) * signedCompletionDefect (k + 2) x y +
        x * y * powerDifferenceCofactor (k + 1) x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionDefect
declarations.source_signature: def completionDefect (n x y : ℕ) : ℕ

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionDefect_add_cofactor
declarations.source_signature:
theorem completionDefect_add_cofactor (n x y : ℕ) :
    completionDefect n x y + powerDifferenceCofactor n x y =
      (x + y) ^ (n - 1)

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionDefect_zero
declarations.source_signature: @[simp] theorem completionDefect_zero (x y : ℕ) : completionDefect 0 x y = 1

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionDefect_one
declarations.source_signature: @[simp] theorem completionDefect_one (x y : ℕ) : completionDefect 1 x y = 0

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionDefect_two
declarations.source_signature: @[simp] theorem completionDefect_two (x y : ℕ) : completionDefect 2 x y = 0

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionDefect_recurrence
declarations.source_signature:
theorem completionDefect_recurrence (k x y : ℕ) :
    completionDefect (k + 3) x y =
      (x + y) * completionDefect (k + 2) x y +
        x * y * powerDifferenceCofactor (k + 1) x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionDefect_three
declarations.source_signature: @[simp] theorem completionDefect_three (x y : ℕ) : completionDefect 3 x y = x * y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.completionDefect_pos
declarations.source_signature:
theorem completionDefect_pos {n x y : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) (hx : 0 < x) (hy : 0 < y) :
    0 < completionDefect n x y

declarations.name: DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.powerDifferenceCofactor_lt
DkMath.Lib.Cosmic.cast_completionDefect
declarations.source_signature:
theorem cast_completionDefect {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n x y : ℕ) :
    (completionDefect n x y : R) = signedCompletionDefect n (x : R) (y : R)
